Independent recount from the same nine final ANSI captures: 17 unselected node occurrences covered, only 6 selected occurrences covered, 11 selected occurrences missing. No observed border defect; correction of prior coverage overclaim.

semantic_fidelity.reason: All eight nodes and eight directed endpoint pairs exist; overview covers all and seams/execution repeat four each with shared engine continuity. However required task-input and management meanings are omitted, user-process specificity is lost, and starts/manages and the seams HTTP-over-UDS label are not uniquely attached. JSON coverage cannot rescue these capture-level failures (F01–F05).

arrow_traceability.reason: All eight distinct directed relations are traceable stem-to-unique-head in each occurrence (16 total paths across three views). Both worker/runtime directions use separate routes. Runtime and engine fan out using distinct ports without shared runs; no fake branch, crossing or extra apparent endpoint relation occurs. Label-meaning/association defects are scored under semantic_fidelity, not misreported as missing arrow geometry.

layout_fit.reason: Actual tty measurements and all nine ANSI grids establish 77×47. Native four-row boxes and recorded default launches/no pan-or-zoom support natural 100%. All complete graph boxes, rendered graph labels and heads fit in all states and views; controls do not occlude them. Graph extents: overview [8,6,63,37], seams [23,15,32,20], execution [17,15,45,20]. Header help fragments are clipped, but no required graph label is clipped. Timing/launch archival defects are separately failed under workflow_evidence.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Geometric row depth determines hue, including unsupported same-hue groups of backend/filesystem/daemon and container/Blobnet. Source execution/container and filesystem/storage relations are not expressed as related hue families. The source does not define these geometric tiers; no visible legend qualifies them (F06). Cross-view color changes are corroboration, not a separate fixed-color requirement.

border_integrity.reason: The prior pass overcounted frame instances as selected-state coverage. The same nine final ANSI captures prove complete, uniformly colored borders for all 17 node occurrences unselected and only 6 occurrences selected: overview backend/filesystem, seams daemon/engine, execution backend/container. Of 51 frame instances, 45 are unselected and 6 selected; repeated unselected instances do not establish selected borders. Selected evidence is missing for 11 occurrences: overview worker/runtime/engine/daemon/container/Blobnet; seams worker/runtime; execution engine/filesystem/Blobnet. Captured selected perimeters are uniformly bold amber, and all observed borders/handles are correct. No observed border defect is asserted. The every-node selected-state criterion remains blocked by missing evidence, not passed by extrapolation.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen candidate, binary, rubric, dataset, case source/expected, three specs and all eighteen final capture hashes match. DeepSeek generator identity matches metadata/generation; this separate Astra judge identity is confirmed by session env. Blind report hash is unchanged. Final --check stdout, empty stderr and exit=0 are preserved. Nevertheless overview chronology/launch/cleanup evidence is incomplete and contradictory, and submitted selected-state descriptions conflict with ANSI (F07,F08). Six helper pane closures are recorded; overview closure is only asserted. Selected-state coverage is also incomplete: only 6 of 17 node occurrences have selected ANSI evidence, leaving 11 blocked; repeated unselected appearances do not fill that gap. This is missing evidence, not an observed border defect. Known F07/F08 record failures keep workflow_evidence at fail rather than blocked-only.

animation.reason: Frozen modal-runtime manifest/expected mark animation optional, and the source user request asks for readable components, seams, modules and RPCs without requesting motion. Thus animation is not requested for this case. All final specs contain no flows, headers say 0 flows, and no dot appears; no unrequested motion damages paths. No speed/direction claim is inferred from still frames. This is N/A, not a pass.

edge_audit.expected: worker → runtime: task input + control RPCs. Independent directed relationship; not a bus.
edge_audit.observed: overview: worker→runtime; stem [12, 10, 1, 2], route [[11, 12, 2, 1]], target head [11, 13, 1, 1]; label 'control gRPC' at [14, 11, 12, 1]. seams: worker→runtime; stem [25, 19, 1, 2], route [[24, 21, 2, 1]], target head [24, 22, 1, 1]; label 'control gRPC' at [27, 20, 12, 1]. Downward edge is clear. Label means control only, missing task input; its final character abuts the unrelated return corridor, but path tracing remains possible. No edge-edge crossing, shared run, unintended junction or missing head is visible.

findings.description: The required worker→runtime seam carries task input AND control RPCs. Both final views say only control gRPC. Task-input meaning is absent from every visible label/legend. The prose abbreviation expansion in generation.json cannot restore a missing source concept in the diagram.

The required runtime→worker seam carries events AND management RPCs. Both final views say only events gRPC; management meaning is omitted everywhere in the rendered set. Endpoints and direction are correct, but this is a narrower relationship than the frozen source.

starts/manages is visibly between two heads and directly below the filesystem branch in both overview and execution. Blind Stage A could not uniquely associate it with engine→backend. Reading the revealed JSON establishes author intent, not capture readability; neither occurrence independently preserves that label-to-edge association.

In seams, fs HTTP over UDS starts beside the daemon approach but lies beneath the engine horizontal route and ends flush against its vertical route. Blind Stage A left its exclusive association unknown. Overview is clear, but it does not rescue a misleading required detail view or establish that HTTP-over-UDS belongs to daemon from the seams capture alone.

runs process preserves the execution direction/action but drops the source qualifier user from runs user process in both occurrences. No rendered legend restores that distinction. This is a localized label-meaning loss, not a reversed or missing topological edge.

The hue families encode geometric rows rather than the source-described execution/container and filesystem/storage concepts. Overview groups backend, filesystem and daemon as three green siblings while the closely related container and Blobnet form an unrelated shared blue tier; execution similarly gives backend/filesystem teal and container/Blobnet pink. No source-defined tier or legend supports those same-hue groups. Seams then pairs daemon with engine in pink. Cross-view hue changes corroborate the depth encoding, but hue stability alone is not an added rubric requirement.

Overview executed provenance is internally inconsistent: generation/commands claim launch 08:25:29Z and captures 08:25:30–08:25:38Z, but the frozen manifest records text-none at 08:25:01Z, ANSI-none at 08:25:24Z and right-selected at 08:25:44Z. Its timeline contains only three unlabelled times; no exact per-view launch record, per-state event log or p2Z close response was preserved. The actual captures are readable and hash-match, but the complete reproducible state/timing/cleanup chain cannot be verified.

Generation state descriptions are incorrect: seams sel-tab highlights modal-daemon, not modal-worker; execution sel-tab highlights Container backend, not Task engine. Execution sel-right highlights Task container. Generator route coordinates also contain off-by-one errors (overview reverse head is [25,7], not [24,7]). Independent ANSI evidence corrects these facts, but the submitted workflow state/coverage record is not reliable as written.

These regions identify the unselected boxes whose selected-state evidence is absent. No existing final capture shows those occurrences selected; no new rendering was performed and no border defect is inferred.

Overview capture event timestamps and exact launch/close sequence cannot be recovered from the retained record: three bare timeline entries conflict with generation claims and artifact timestamps. No new rendering or pane query was performed.
Owned overview pane w7E:p2Z closure is asserted in generation.json but lacks a retained per-step close event/final pane-list response; verified cleanup covers the other six panes only.

No missing model/tool capability was observed. The frozen documented spec exposes neither semantic per-node/group colors independent of layout nor explicit edge-label anchors; label-placement and color fixes may need renderer support, but this review did not inspect code or test unsupported fields.

cleanup.reason: Six helper timelines record successful self-close. The original overview p2Z close and final single-pane state appear only as retrospective generator assertions; no retained event/output verifies them. This judge created no panes and performed no live pane/session operation.
